description: What this organization still has to do before its LinkedIn is actually working for it, and the one call that does the next bit. Answers ready, next and steps: connect a LinkedIn account; add the organization's own AI key (which goes in on a page, never through you); start a content campaign so the account posts regularly; start a boost or Top Voices campaign so the right people see it; open a project room and point the campaigns at it; connect the channels the answers come back on; set the campaigns running. Each step says whether it is done, why it matters, and the exact call to make, worked out from what this organization actually has. A step that reads unknown is one this deployment cannot see either way - never treat it as done. Call this at the start of a conversation about setting anything up, and again after each step. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /linkedin/setup, group campaigns.
